messages:
amy_support: Customer reports repeated JSON parse failures when using structured output (json mode). They say a nested array of items sometimes contains partial objects (missing required 'product_id'), and other items have an extra key 'trace_meta' inserted. Parser fails and client ends up retrying, which blew up their bill.

leo_eng: Can you paste the minimal repro and the exact model response payload? Also which model + version?

amy_support: Pasted from customer (sanitized):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{
  "model": "open-variant-xlarge:2025-04-01",
  "mode": "structured_json",
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["product_id","qty"]}}}},
  "prompt": "return order items as json array under 'items'"
}'

Response from model (as returned in body):

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "items": [
    {"product_id": "sku-123", "qty": 1},
    {"qty": 2, "note": "gift"},              # <-- missing product_id
    {"product_id": "sku-789", "qty": 1, "trace_meta": {"trace_id": "abc"}} # <-- unexpected extra key
  ]
}

Client-side parse error: json.parse error at character 142: expected key 'product_id' in item 2. Customer client library then retried the call twice (exponential backoff), which multiplied token usage. They attached billing spikes by timestamp.

karen_sre: Do we have any service-side schema enforcement for structured_json mode? My understanding: we validate shape but allow extra keys unless strict=true. If the model omitted required key the validator should return a 422 with details, not let malformed payload through.

leo_eng: Looking at the logs I pulled for that API key (shared via private link), I see the runtime returned HTTP 200 for the request and the structured output post-processing attempted to coerce. The validator flagged the missing required key and put an error in logs, but a downstream step returned the raw body to the customer because our 'strict_mode' flag was off for that tenant. That explains why the client got a parse exception.

david_billing: Short-term: we should issue a one-time usage credit for the spike and recommend the customer turn off client retries while we investigate. Also consider automatic suppression of retryable billing when failures are caused by schema mismatches in structured output.

amy_support: Customer asked for repro steps so they can test: 1) send request in structured mode with that schema, 2) model returns array with one item missing product_id and another with extra key, 3) client lib throws parse error. They gave us stacktrace: 

  File "client.py", line 88, in parse
    items = resp_json['items']
  File "/usr/lib/python3.9/json/__init__.py", line 293, in loads
    return _default_decoder.decode(s)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 142 (char 141)

leo_eng: Action items for engineering: 1) confirm behavior when strict_mode=false for structured_json -> does runtime return raw model output or a 422? 2) add tenant-level guardrail to return 422 with structured validation errors when schema required fields are missing (prevent client parse exceptions). 3) create opt-in 'strip_extra_keys' fallback to remove unexpected keys instead of failing (configurable).

karen_sre: Also add a telemetry flag to mark requests that would have been retried by client so billing team can analyze refunds patterns.

david_billing: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and prepare the one-time credit. Also need the request IDs and timestamps from logs (leo please attach).

amy_support: I've told the customer: disable retries for now, we escalated to eng, and billing will follow up. They've asked for ETA.

leo_eng: I'll take ownership. ETA for preliminary fix (fail fast with 422 on missing required nested keys) - 48h to patch, then QA. For the fallback stripping extra keys we'll scope in the next sprint.

support-bot: Ticket created: INC-2025-4892 (assigned to leo_eng). Please add any log links in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

amy_support: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with the INC ID and the temporary mitigation (disable retries) and note the 48h ETA. :thumbsup:
